svg.title: M04: pin the rule before the run and preserve it for later assessment
svg.desc: Before work, a published dated policy is validated and pinned to the run. The live adapter invokes evaluation using the already-loaded policy without calling the register. Later tests use the original specification and evaluator references, even after a newer release is published.
svg.text: M04 · A rule is selected before it judges the work.
Proposed design · sample IDs and token limits are illustrative · no live implementation claimed
BEFORE GOVERNED WORK — AUTHOR, VALIDATE, PIN

g.title: The policy register retains dated definitions and mappings, outside the execution path
Validate source references, scope, compatibility and exact immutable versions before opening work
g.text: No silent fallback to easier rules

g.title: Run FM-001 retains bundle G-FM-v1 throughout its declared continuation period
Loader reads the selected authorized release before work begins
Run start persists the exact policy binding
The already-loaded rule is an input to evaluation; the register is not called in the live request path
g.text: carry the pinned rule as input

svg.text: DURING A MODEL REQUEST — NO REGISTER LOOKUP

g.title: M02 receives trusted M03 context and invokes one normalized evaluation interface
Resolve the pinned control mapping and apply pure evaluation plus separate atomic coordination if inline admission is implemented
The response is tied to this attempt and the original rule version
One synchronous decision request at a verified enforcement point
Return the decision for the exact pinned policy and attempted action

svg.text: AFTER THE RUN — REPRODUCE THE ORIGINAL TEST

g.title: Historical queries still load expired or superseded policy versions for the original assessed work
g.text: Judge query → actual evidence + G-FM-v1 + referenced evaluator → versioned assessment
10,800 tokens against the original 10,000 cap remains a breach even if a later release sets a 12,000 cap.
Publishing v2 applies to eligible new runs. Expiry, hard cutoff and urgent revocation have separately declared behavior.

svg.text: Runtime stop/state checks are separate from policy publication. Log-only integrations cannot physically stop model requests.
C9 pins its baseline/scorer/window definition before assessed cases; it does not inherit a convenient rule at query time.
